steps: Independently review per-image visible-route, background, branch/contact, field-mark, copy/occlusion and clipping labels. Enumerate all relevant feeders/route intervals; reject unavailable intervals rather than extending masks.

Declare one observable apparent-core quantity for each source/local role before evaluation. A contrast-magnitude method capable of measuring dark red and bright cyan requires controlled semantic negatives, reviewed route-normal orientation and error challenges; this packet supplies no acceptance threshold for it.

Obtain matched route-disabled background and component-separated core/bloom or glow source/local evidence with known camera, capture profile, source/local effect age and exact frame binding. This makes subtraction attributable rather than relying on a guessed baseline under luminous marks.

Use independent labelled edge intervals or known-support renderer challenges to measure worst-case localization error across red/cyan, graded tails, branches, contact, pulse, copy and clipping. Freeze thresholds and an error envelope before applying them to withheld retained sections.

Preserve blocked outcomes for coverage gaps, saturation/occlusion, unsupported source timing and unavailable component readback. Have an independent reviewer qualify the complete correspondence packet before geometry consumption.

preciseRetainedEvidenceBoundary: Pixels outside image bounds and pixels occluded by copy/scene objects are not recorded. They cannot establish complete route extent or hidden core thickness without inventing support.
Single composited frames cannot attribute overlapping field marks to beam bloom, establish a pulse's causal phase, or recover the latent no-route background at every route section.
The current helper's positive mean profile does not cover the red route class, and its total residual envelope includes detached non-route components. No calibrated subject-edge error is available.
All raw frames are the historical packet. Their exact hashes cannot prove current implementation/capture provenance or source/local animation-age correspondence.
